verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents only fixed, built-in automations. Its data room auto-collects documents, the Gusto integration auto-grants equity from offer-letter promises, and approvals are built into workflows. None of these lets a user define their own event-triggered rules, so they are adjacent features rather than the story's capability. As an equity-management SaaS, a user-configurable rules engine is a fair axis, but there is no evidence one exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
